allowedSources: Official GATE EE/EC papers and matching authentic answer keys
Previously supplied ACE classroom questions, distinctly labeled
notes: All 34 year-branch combinations are indexed; older-year URL candidates are not verified PDFs or gradeable questions.
Original PDF existence does not mean its individual questions, options, diagrams, year/branch/sessions, official keys or subject tags have been imported.
No 2010-2021 question can enter the daily CBT until a matched official answer key, exact source image, subject review, and uniqueness checks pass.
Keep question ID as YEAR-BRANCH-SESSION-QNUMBER for multiple-session papers to avoid collisions.
2010 original paper uses different technical/GA numbering and linked-answer conventions; do not treat like later CBT.
Control Systems is in the collection request but remains excluded from the technical daily test unless the user changes that rule.
For older PDFs not reachable through the IIT Kanpur mirror, the GATE 2027 official download page links a Google Drive bulk archive of source question papers 2007–2026.
